about.title: About
about.body: Algorithmius is a multilingual reference for studying, reviewing, and reusing common algorithms. Each entry pairs a concise explanation with a complete implementation.
about.principles: Keep explanations concise, keep code readable, and keep the interface out of the way. Content is managed through a protected administrator area and stored in Supabase PostgreSQL.
